doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: New Orleans Strut and second line groove
summary: He explains it was a tribute to New Orleans music, with a second line drum beat.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: I was just listening to that this morning and your “New Orleans Strut” that you wrote I think for your father is very hooky. Really sticks in your head.

I actually didn’t write it for my father, I wrote it for the music that comes from New Orleans. You know, and actually the drum beat I kind of used on there is from like s/l Zigaboo*** 45:36 who plays with the — what do you call it — what’s the last name — you know the which is made up of — I can’t think of the names right now. But yeah I mean I like that kind of second line groove. So that was a kind of tribute to New Orleans.
